paper_title: Axion-Like Particles and Recent Observations of the Cosmic Infrared Background Radiation
suggested_experiment_name: CIBER + IRTS + AKARI combined constraint on axion-photon coupling
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: This paper presents a THEORETICAL ALLOWED REGION (not an exclusion limit) in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane that would resolve tension between CIBER CIB observations and TeV gamma-ray data via axion-photon oscillations. The region is bounded by: (1) lower mass/coupling boundary from Hillas condition (photon-axion conversion in source jets), (2) upper coupling boundary from CAST experiment (g_agamma < 8.8×10^-11 GeV^-1 for m_a ≲ 0.02 eV), and (3) left boundary from intergalactic oscillation constraints. The paper derives the allowed band as m_a ~ 7×10^-10 to 5×10^-8 eV and 1.5×10^-11 ≲ g_agamma ≲ 8.8×10^-10 GeV^-1 from χ² fitting to H2356-309 and 1ES1101-232 TeV blazar spectra. The two data points encode the corners of this allowed region as a horizontal band. This is NOT a new direct experimental exclusion but rather a parameter space inference from astrophysical consistency arguments.
